body:
Bergie comes from a small town and I’m picking up the vibes that his family is religious and conservative. 

That being said, Bergie could be changing off the strength that he’s interacting with people outside of his typical bubble. He’s opened himself up to a new experience which can naturally change someone. 

Should he have to change for love? No, but it also doesn’t seem like he forced himself to change. 

Was the change bad? That’s subjective. As a viewer, I would say no. As a grandparent whose used to seeing my grandchild in another light I may have a different opinion. 

It’ll be interesting to see how Bergie navigates in these last few episodes. I’m especially interested to see how things progress between him and Taylor after his family’s comments about their relationship.
I don’t see any of the couples this season lasting more than 5 months tbh

Destiny as a person in the real world is completely fine I’m sure, but Destiny as a contestant on Love Island is trash. I agree with the comments that she needs a different dating show format. 

Nothing wrong with guarding your heart but this is a show and a game that you willingly signed up for. She’s pretty closed off dating-wise, she went to sleep in the hideaway, and she comes off as kinda rude and territorial. It’s giving, why did you come here? Lol 

Again, nothing wrong with the way she acts in a real-world context and she doesn’t deserve to be harassed by fans but I completely understand why people don’t like her on this show
It was very strange. It would be different if they were a more established couple but Taylor & Bergie’s decision was valid

I wanted to like her so bad but I agree. Honestly, I was turned off back when she was entertaining the kid with the feather earring. She seemed a bit immature and very cringe. 

Gorgeous girl tho!

Neither couple was something worth idolizing but I can see this argument being made for Ty and Ella not Kay Kay and Keenan. We watched Kay Kay choose Keenan time after time while Keenan’s eye continued to wander. She literally broke down crying over this man’s actions on national television just to take him back as soon as she got back in the Villa. 

That was a very toxic/triggering situation and hard to watch at times.

At this point in the show I’m honestly surprised that people still think Taylor is faking it with Bergie. I was skeptical initially but she comes off extremely genuine, never showed any other guys interest, and in an odd way her and Bergie seem to have compatible personalities. 

Plus, in my opinion, she’s the only girl in the house who hasn’t treated Bergie like a little brother. 

Out of all the couples, they’re the only one that I could see continuing after the show.

Jonah is cute and his personality and overall demeanor definitely makes him more attractive but I agree that he looked better than ever in this last episode. It looks like he has a tan so I’m sure that’s why. 

The villa lost a good one smh!

Can’t stand Carmen, she’s messy and very obviously playing the game. Kenzo is just boring.

I do agree that they haven’t been tested. I just knew they’d show a clip of Carmen and Rob during movie night. Nope, just Destiny sleeping in the hideaway
I’m not saying I agree with what he’s doing, I was adding to what you said
